category_title: Students with severe hearing impairment and EAL who use physical gestures and lip-reading to decipher archaic language
scenario_title: Initial engagement with text and general classroom tasks
minimal_context: The student is working on a general English classroom task that requires writing a response to a text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read the text and write a paragraph about what happens in the story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains very quiet during the lesson and looks down at the paper without speaking.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you will write about?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Uses very basic verbal communication, saying only a single word, and writes down one sentence.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, please write some more sentences to finish the task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the pen down, having written no more than one sentence for the task. He stays very quiet and rarely verbally contributes anything else.)
